title: "Over 100 Applicants" (GOOD NEWS)
description:
“Over 100 applicants” is incredibly deflating when you see that on a job you like, but it doesn’t mean what you think it does. That number is actually just clicks to the application but LinkedIn doesn’t have any way of knowing who’s finishing applying. That number really means somewhat serious interest int the role so if you do see it just spend some extra time and dial in your application materials…but really you should do that with every app anyway. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
